title: Yash Highvoltage Ltd (BSE:YASHHV) — Institutional Research Dossier
holding_rationale: Yash Highvoltage is not held (0 shares) in our Zerodha India portfolio. Total net worth is ₹42,64,304.99 with ₹14,20,949.94 in cash. We already hold 13.68% in power and T&D stocks across TD Power, APAR, and TARIL. Business quality earns a Compounder Pass. Still, shares closed at ₹1,237.25 on the live November 25 TradingView feed and ₹1,225.50 on the November 23 BSE ledger. That prices the stock at 60.15x TTM P/E on 3.150 crore fully diluted shares (including 8.3 lakh Malabar warrants and ESOP 2025). Fresh risks include ₹40.9 crore of Sep–Nov promoter selling, a ₹2.10 crore cyber-fraud loss, and a six-month Jarod trial slip ahead of MGC Moser Glaser's mid-2027 sunset. USTR's November 25 India tariff proposal (up to 25%), Hitachi Energy's Halol plant, and BSE SME lock-in through December 2027 add more friction. Our Base Target is ₹1,200 (42x FY28E diluted EPS of ₹28.57), and Expected Value is ₹1,174 (-5.1%). Live Stage 2 support (₹1,161.90–₹1,197.28; stop ₹949.50) offers just 0.01:1 reward-to-risk. We therefore reject new capital on Valuation at Tier 0.

holding_alerts.instruction: No active buy order. Re-underwrite only if a valuation reset brings shares into ₹950–₹1,020 (33x–36x FY28E diluted EPS), restoring at least 1.50:1 reward-to-risk to ₹1,200.
Audit H2 FY27 filings and November 27 plant-visit takeaways for commercial indigenous RIP cores before mid-2027, US tariff exemptions, DSO below 60 days, and zero further promoter sales.
Reference-only technical floor below Pivot S2 (₹962.33) and the 30-week SMA (₹974.51). Zero shares are held, so no stop order is needed.

primer: Yash Highvoltage Ltd (BSE:YASHHV) is India's sole pure-play condenser bushing maker and keeps a Compounder Pass. H1 FY27 revenue jumped 95% YoY to ₹194.5 crore with ₹95 crore net cash and a ₹760+ crore backlog. Still, our refresh rejects new capital on Valuation (Tier 0; 0% allocation) at ₹1,237.25 live close (₹1,225.50 Nov 23 BSE ledger; 60.15x P/E). Full dilution (3.150 crore shares), ₹40.9 crore promoter sales, cyber-fraud lapses, mid-2027 Swiss supply expiry, and proposed 25% US tariffs cap Base fair value at ₹1,200 (EV ₹1,174; -5.1%). Live Stage 2 support (₹1,161.90–₹1,197.28; stop ₹949.50) offers just 0.01:1 reward-to-risk, so we keep cash sidelined until ₹950–₹1,020.
